fusions.name: Open the Old Cut
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that reopens an old cut: it deals 9 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Thousand Cuts at Once
fusions.desc: Every rat in your swarm cuts at once, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles plus 4% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaving each [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Into the Wainscot
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, you move 15% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Shiv in the Straw
fusions.desc: Conjures a shiv gnawed to an edge: it increases your weapon damage by 12% and your attack speed by 5%, and every strike with it leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a tick for 2 ticks.
